method.qualityUnlabeledRule: A query with no previously adjudicated target is recorded QUALITY_UNLABELED. No relevance judgement is invented for it.
method.latencyCaveat: pg_stat_activity is sampled at the start of every row. A latency without the concurrent load beside it is an anecdote on this box.
method.coldWarmRule: The FIRST run of every row is reported separately as coldFirstRunMs and excluded from p50/p95. It is routinely 5x the settled value with zero other active backends, so it measures cache state rather than the query. p95IsMaxOfSample is true whenever the warm sample is under 20 runs, which is the honest reading of a percentile over a handful of points.
